items.title: Google Cloud Revenue Could Overtake Search In 2028. Can It Be A Cash Machine?
items.summary: In a big transition for Google stock, cloud revenue could overtake search ads in 2028. But that doesn't mean cloud will be a cash engine.

items.title: WiseStamp Announces Integration with HiBob, Automating and Controlling Employee Data in Email Signatures
items.summary: WiseStamp, the leading email signature management platform, today announced the launch of its new integration with HiBob, a Human Resources System used by thousands of businesses managing hundreds of thousands of employees worldwide.

items.title: Chubu Electric Power Grid Launches 10 Millionth Smart Meter with Oracle
items.summary: Chubu Electric Power Grid Co., Inc. has deployed 10 million smart meters, marking a critical milestone in its Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) initiative with Oracle. Following an upgrade to the latest version of Oracle Utilities Meter Data Management (MDM), the utility is now benefitting from improved scalability, interval-readiness, and operational resilience across its commercial and residential meters. With this implementation, Chubu Electric Power Grid can meet current business goals
